shortBio.en: Radiohead singer-writer; also solo and Atoms for Peace projects beside a stable five-piece.
shortBio.zh: Radiohead 主唱-写作者；在稳定五人组旁还有独唱与 Atoms for Peace 项目。

whyHub.en: Stable band lineup can still host a person who branches into parallel projects.
whyHub.zh: 稳定乐队阵容仍可承载侧向分支到平行项目的人物。

body.en:
Born 1968. Radiohead’s uneasy vocal center from Pablo Honey through experimental eras. Solo (The Eraser) and Atoms for Peace show electronic/jazz-adjacent work without dissolving the main band.

Third pattern beside Ozzy (fired-and-solo) and Grohl (drummer-to-frontman): parallel selves.
body.zh:
1968 年生。从 Pablo Honey 到实验时期，Radiohead 不安的人声中心。独唱（The Eraser）与 Atoms for Peace 展示电子/爵士邻近工作，而不解散主乐队。

相对 Ozzy（被撤后独唱）与 Grohl（鼓手转主唱）的第三模式：平行自我。
